queries.purpose: query history: builds in the last 30 days
queries.sql:
with builds as (
  select
    regexp_substr(query_text, '"node_id": ?"(model[.][^"]+)"', 1, 1, 'e', 1) as node_id,
    query_type, query_text, bytes_scanned, execution_time, warehouse_size
  from snowflake.account_usage.query_history
  where start_time > dateadd(day, -30, current_timestamp())
    and execution_status = 'SUCCESS'
    and query_type in ('CREATE_TABLE_AS_SELECT', 'CREATE_TABLE', 'INSERT', 'MERGE')
),
named as (
  select *, upper(replace(case query_type when 'MERGE' then regexp_substr(left(query_text, 2000), 'merge[[:space:]]+into[[:space:]]+([^[:space:](]+)', 1, 1, 'ie', 1) when 'INSERT' then regexp_substr(left(query_text, 2000), 'insert[[:space:]]+(overwrite[[:space:]]+)?into[[:space:]]+([^[:space:](]+)', 1, 1, 'ie', 2) else regexp_substr(left(query_text, 2000), 'create[[:space:]]+(or[[:space:]]+replace[[:space:]]+)?((transient|temporary|temp)[[:space:]]+)?table[[:space:]]+(if[[:space:]]+not[[:space:]]+exists[[:space:]]+)?([^[:space:](]+)', 1, 1, 'ie', 5) end, '"', '')) as target,
    regexp_replace(target, '__DBT_TMP$', '') as relation,
    split_part(relation, '.', -1) as table_name
  from builds
)
select
  node_id, relation,
  count_if(coalesce(not endswith(target, '__DBT_TMP'), true)) as runs,
  sum(execution_time) / 1000 / greatest(runs, 1) as seconds_per_build,
  median(bytes_scanned) as bytes_scanned,
  mode(warehouse_size) as warehouse_size
from named
where node_id in ('model.event_analytics.base_events_adapter', 'model.event_analytics.base_events_command', 'model.event_analytics.base_events_invocation', 'model.event_analytics.invocations', 'model.event_analytics.stg_events_adapter', 'model.event_analytics.stg_events_command', 'model.event_analytics.stg_events_invocation') or (node_id is null and table_name in ('BASE_EVENTS_ADAPTER', 'BASE_EVENTS_COMMAND', 'BASE_EVENTS_INVOCATION', 'INVOCATIONS', 'STG_EVENTS_ADAPTER', 'STG_EVENTS_COMMAND', 'STG_EVENTS_INVOCATION'))
group by node_id, relation

select 'model.event_analytics.invocations' as node_id, to_varchar(system$explain_plan_json($$select
    i.invocation_id,
    i.dbt_version,
    count(c.event_id) as commands
from EVENTS.dbt_fixture.stg_events_invocation i
left join EVENTS.dbt_fixture.stg_events_command c using (invocation_id)
group by 1, 2$$)) as plan
union all
select 'model.event_analytics.stg_events_adapter' as node_id, to_varchar(system$explain_plan_json($$-- A table, so it compiles offline: its colon paths and dateadd get checked.


select
    event_id,
    emitted_at,
    payload:adapter_type::varchar as adapter_type,
    dateadd(day, 1, emitted_at) as expires_at
from EVENTS.dbt_fixture.base_events_adapter$$)) as plan
